# Tax Documentation: Retrieve Tax Documentation Status

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`GET /tax-documentation-status` · account-owner-scoped token

Returns the latest tax documentation status for an account owner across all form types (W-9/W-8, Digital Platform Seller, and Self-Certification).

**Response 200**: Tax documentation status

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `submission_status` | string | No | The account owner's tax documentation submission status. Present only while no tax documentation has been submitted under the account owner; once documentation exists this field is omitted and the per-questionnaire status objects are returned instead. Deprecated for SDK versions >= 1.0. One of: `NOT_SUBMITTED`. **Deprecated.** |
| `days_since_establishment` | integer | No | The number of days since the account owner has established/created an account in your system. |
| `dps_questionnaire` | object | No | Status fields related to the Digital Platform Seller (DPS) questionnaire. |
| `dps_questionnaire.data_collection_status` | string | Yes | The questionnaire collection status. Questionnaire collection status refers to the status of required information for a particular questionnaire. One of: `COMPLETE`, `INCOMPLETE`. |
| `dps_questionnaire.tax_documentation_status` | string | Yes | Indicates whether the most recent DPS submission has passed validation checks. A status of Valid means the submission has been accepted as complete and accurate. A status of Invalid means the submission contains issues or missing information that must be corrected before it can be used for reporting. One of: `VALID`, `INVALID`. |
| `dps_questionnaire.needs_resubmission` | boolean | Yes | Indicates if the end user should be prompted to submit a new DPS questionnaire. |
| `dps_questionnaire.expiration_date` | string (date-time) | No | The date when the DPS questionnaire expires, which is 3 years after submission. |
| `dps_questionnaire.vat_status` | string | No | The VAT validation status indicates the outcome or condition of the tax-related Value Added Tax (VAT) verification process. One of: `PENDING`, `VALID`, `INVALID`, `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, `NOT_REQUIRED`, `NON_EU`. |
| `dps_questionnaire.vat_validation_date` | string (date-time) | No | The date when the VAT was validated. |
| `dps_questionnaire.issues` | array of object | No | An array of issues on the DPS Questionnaire. |
| `dps_questionnaire.issues[].issue_type` | string | Yes | Specifies the category of issue identified on the W-8, W-9, or Self-Certification form. One of: `CARE_OF_PERMANENT_ADDRESS`, `PO_BOX_PERMANENT_ADDRESS`, `US_PERMANENT_ADDRESS`, `TREATY_COUNTRY_MISMATCH`, `US_INDICIA`, `WITHHOLDING_DOCUMENTATION`, `CHANGE_IN_CIRCUMSTANCES`, `INCOMPLETE_ADDRESS`, `INCOMPLETE_DATA`, `INCONSISTENT_DATA`, `INCOMPLETE_CLASSIFICATION`, `INCOMPLETE_US_TIN`, `INCOMPLETE_TREATY_CLAIM`, `INCOMPLETE_GIIN`, `CBI_RBI_CONFIRMATION`. |
| `dps_questionnaire.issues[].status` | string | No | The current remediation state of the issue. `OPEN` means the issue still needs to be addressed, `IN_REVIEW` means the issue is being reviewed, and `RESOLVED` means the issue no longer applies. One of: `RESOLVED`, `OPEN`, `IN_REVIEW`. |
| `dps_questionnaire.issues[].created_at` | string (date-time) | No | The date and time the issue was created. |
| `dps_questionnaire.issues[].details` | array of object | No | An array of details on the issue. |
| `dps_questionnaire.issues[].details[].field` | string | Yes | The field name that triggered the issue. |
